definitions.explanation: The state of a liquid heating to the point where it bubbles and produces steam (100°C for water at sea level).
Figuratively used to describe a state of intense excitement or agitation.

notes:
{沸騰|ふっとう} means boiling — when a liquid reaches its boiling point and produces bubbles and steam. Also used figuratively for intense excitement or agitation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {沸騰|ふっとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to boil)
- {沸騰|ふっとう}⟦させる→させる：noentry⟧ (to bring to a boil)
- {沸騰|ふっとう}⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (boiling point — literal and figurative)
- ⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{沸騰|ふっとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (the water boils)

USAGE:
- ⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{沸騰|ふっとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (public opinion erupts)
- ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{沸騰|ふっとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (the venue is in a frenzy)
- Used for intense public reactions, heated debates, or excitement reaching a peak

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{沸|わ}く→沸く：01122_waku⟧: to boil (intransitive, everyday word)
- ⟦{沸|わ}かす→沸かす：01105_wakasu⟧: to boil (transitive, to heat water)
- ⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧: to simmer, cook in liquid
- {沸騰|ふっとう} is more technical/dramatic than ⟦{沸|わ}く→沸く：01122_waku⟧
